-- True when the path, written as a relative name, never climbs above its start.
stays_inside(path: str) -> bool =
  ex stays_inside("a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("..") == False
  ex stays_inside("sub/../../x") == False
  ex stays_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  var i = 0
  for c in path.chars()
    if c == "\\"
      return False
    if c == "/" and i == 0
      return False
    i += 1
  var depth = 0
  for seg in path.split("/")
    if seg == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
      continue
    if seg != "" and seg != "."
      depth += 1
  True

-- Text of the file at `path` inside `notes`, or "" if the path escapes,
-- or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post stays_inside(path) or out == ""
  ex read_public("..") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  ex read_public("sub/../../x") == ""
  if not stays_inside(path)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    return fs.read(path) else ""
